activate_witch_bolt.desc1: Activate Witch Bolt is a cantrip (Evocation). It allows spellcasters to electrocute targets connected by Witch Bolt dealing 1d12⁠Lightning damage.

aid.name: Aid
aid.desc1: Aid is a level 2 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to heal and embolden their allies and themselves with resolve. Affected creatures have their maximum Hit Points increased for the duration of the spell.

animal_friendship.name: Animal Friendship
animal_friendship.desc1: Animal Friendship is a level 1 enchantment spell. It charms a beast, convincing it the caster means no harm.
animal_friendship.desc2: Convince a beast not to attack you. The creature must have an Intelligence of 4 or less.Condition ends early if you or an ally hurts the target.In higher difficulty modes, the target might become hostile when the spell ends.

animate_dead.desc1: Animate Dead is a level 3 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to animate a corpse to create an undead servant.
animate_dead.desc2: Animate a corpse to create an undead servant while not in combat. The target must be a Medium or Small corpse.

animate_dead_balthazar.name: Animate Dead (Balthazar)

Beacon of Hope is a level 3 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to bolster their allies with hope and vitality.

Your allies will regain the maximum Hit Points possible when healed. They also gain Advantage on Wisdom Saving throws and Death Saving Throws.

bear_s_endurance.name: Bear's Endurance
bear_s_endurance.desc1: Bear's Endurance is a level 2 transmutation spell. This spell allows spellcasters to bestow a creature the fortitude of a bear. Affected creatures gain Temporary Hit Points and Advantage on Constitution Checks.
bear_s_endurance.desc2: Creature gains Advantage on Constitution Checks and gains 7 Temporary Hit Points. Can only have temporary hit points from one source.
bear_s_endurance.levels: Upcasting: When this Spell is cast at 3rd level or higher, you can target an additional creature for each spell slot level above 2nd.

bestow_curse.desc1: Bestow Curse is a level 3 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to curse a target with their touch.
bestow_curse.desc2: Curse a creature with your touch. The curse either bestows Disadvantage on Ability checks and Saving throws, Disadvantage on Attack rolls, lets you deal additional damage to the target, or robs it of its Actions. The effect of the curse is based on the variant selected, and lasts for 10 turns.

blink.name: Blink
blink.desc1: Blink is a level 3 transmutation spell. It allows the spellcaster to travel to the Ethereal Plane, unassailable and unseen until they return.
blink.desc2: At the end of your turn, roll a d20. On 11 or higher, you vanish into the Ethereal Plane. While there, you can't be harmed or seen in this world. When you do vanish, your presence here is a representation of the location you'll come back to. You can choose to teleport it up to 6 m / 20 ft.Available only in combat.

bolts_of_doom.name: Bolts of Doom
bolts_of_doom.desc1: Bolts of Doom is a level 4 evocation spell. It is a variant of Kereska's Favour that allows its caster to imbue themselves with the power of lightning and unlock resistances and spells associated with it. It is granted by Markoheshkir.
bolts_of_doom.desc2: Embrace Kereska's lightning bolts to gain resistance to ⁠Lightning damage. Your lightning spells deal additional ⁠Lightning damage equal to your proficiency bonus. When you deal spell damage, gain 2[See Notes] Lightning Charges. While attuned to Kereska's lightning you can cast Chain Lightning and Lightning Bolt once each per short rest. Poison a target and possibly afflict them with a disease of your choice. Once infected, the target will roll a Constitution Saving throw each turn. If it accumulates 3 successes, it recovers. If it accumulates 3 failures, it contracts the disease chosen by the spellcaster.

detect_thoughts.desc2: Focus your mind to read the thoughts of certain creatures while talking to them.
detect_thoughts.levels: Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit.

dethrone.name: Dethrone
dethrone.desc1: Dethrone is a level 5 necromancy spell. It is a unique spell which deals a devastating amount of ⁠Necrotic damage to a single target. It can only be learned by wizards through spell scribing.
dethrone.desc2: Shred a foe's very essence by pulling on strands of the Weave.

diabolic_chains.name: Diabolic Chains
diabolic_chains.desc1: Diabolic Chains is a level 6 evocation spell. This spell is available only to Raphael, deals Hellfire damage and pushes back targets 5m. It cannot be learned by players and is only used by NPCs.
diabolic_chains.desc2: Spend 2 souls you have consumed to lash out with 3 magmatic chains of Hellfire and possibly push the targets back 5 m / 17 ft.

dispel_evil_and_good.name: Dispel Evil And Good
dispel_evil_and_good.desc1: Dispel Evil And Good is a level 5 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to protect themselves from Evil and Good creatures, and allows them to break Enchantments on allies.

faerie_fire.desc2: All targets within the light turn visible, and Attack rolls against them have Advantage.
faerie_fire.levels: Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit.

faithwarden_s_vines.name: Faithwarden's Vines
faithwarden_s_vines.desc1: Faithwarden's Vines is a level 1 conjuration spell. This spell allows spellcasters to conjure magical vines and turn an area within range into difficult terrain. Creatures are possibly Entangled and move at half speed while standing in this area. It is equivalent in effect to the Druid's Level 1 Spell Entangle.
faithwarden_s_vines.desc2: Vines sprout from the ground, turning it into Difficult Terrain and possibly Entangling creatures within. Entangled creatures cannot move. An ally can use its help action to try and tear away the vines.
faithwarden_s_vines.levels: Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit.

false_life.name: False Life

fear.name: Fear
fear.desc1: Fear is a level 3 illusion spell. It allows spellcasters to terrify targets by projecting phantasmal images, forcing enemies to flee.
fear.desc2: Hostile targets drop everything and become Fearful: they have Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls. If the target ends their turn where they can't see you, they can make another Saving throw to shake off their fear.

feign_death.name: Feign Death
feign_death.desc1: Feign Death is a level 3 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to put their allies into a magical, protective coma, feigning death.
feign_death.desc2: Put an ally in a protective coma. They become Resistant to all damage except ⁠Psychic. Disease and poison no longer have any effect. Removed when Helped.

fiendish_charm.name: Fiendish Charm
fiendish_charm.desc1: Fiendish Charm is a level 1 enchantment spell. Fiendish Charm is a class action available to Cambions. It allows the user to charm a humanoid enemy, prevented it from attacking the user. It cannot be learned by players and is only used by NPCs.
fiendish_charm.desc2: Charm a humanoid to prevent it from attacking you. You gain Advantage on Charisma Ability Checks in dialogue. You can only Charm a humanoid once per day with this action.Condition ends early if you or an ally hurts the target.In higher difficulty modes, the target might accuse you of enchanting them.

freedom_of_movement.name: Freedom of Movement

frost_of_dark_winter.name: Frost of Dark Winter
frost_of_dark_winter.desc1: Frost of Dark Winter is a level 4 evocation spell. It is a variant of Kereska's Favour that allows its caster to imbue themselves with the power of ice and unlock resistances and spells associated with it. It is granted by Markoheshkir.
frost_of_dark_winter.desc2: Embrace Kereska's ice to gain resistance to ⁠Cold damage. Your cold spells deal additional ⁠Cold damage equal to your proficiency bonus. gaseous_form.name: Gaseous Form
gaseous_form.desc1: Gaseous Form is a level 3 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to transform themselves or an ally into a cloud of mist to avoid attacks, reduce size, and gain Advantage on some Saving Throws.

heat_metal.desc1: Heat Metal is a level 2 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to heat up a metal weapon or armour on the targeted creature, forcing them to let go or receive damage or suffer various penalties.

otiluke_s_resilient_sphere.desc1: Otiluke's Resilient Sphere is a level 4 evocation spell. It surrounds a target in an impenetrable protective sphere which blocks everything from coming in or out of the sphere. scorching_ray.name: Scorching Ray
scorching_ray.desc1: Scorching Ray is a level 2 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to hurl 3 rays of fire at one or more targets within range. Each ray has a separate Attack Roll and deals Fire damage.
scorching_ray.desc2: Hurl 3 rays of fire. Each ray deals 2d6⁠Fire damage.
scorching_ray.levels: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level hurls an additional ray for each spell slot level above 2nd.

searing_smite.name: Searing Smite
searing_smite.desc1: Searing Smite is a level 1 evocation spell. It causes the spellcaster's melee weapon to flare with white-hot intensity, searing their targets on hit.
searing_smite.desc2: Your weapon flares with white-hot intensity. It deals, on top of weapon damage, an extra 1d6⁠⁠Fire damage and marks the target with Searing Smite.
searing_smite.levels: Upcasting: Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 1d6⁠⁠Fire initial damage for each spell slot level above 1st.

searing_smite_azer.name: Searing Smite (Azer)
searing_smite_azer.desc1: Searing Smite is a level 1 evocation spell. It is a unique version of Searing Smite available to azers. Compared with the normal version, it does not consume a  Bonus Action on hit, has a once-per-combat restriction, does not cost spell slots, and of course cannot be upcasted for extra damage. It cannot be learned by players and is only used by NPCs.

see_invisibility.name: See Invisibility
see_invisibility.desc1: See Invisibility is a level 2 divination spell. It allows spellcasters to see Invisible objects and creatures within range while not Incapacitated. Creatures within range which fail a Dexterity Saving Throw lose their invisibility.
see_invisibility.desc2: Become able to see Invisible creatures, and possibly reveal them to others.

sel_ne_s_dream.name: Selûne's Dream
sel_ne_s_dream.desc1: Selûne's Dream is a cantrip (Evocation). It heals an ally, but may also put them to sleep. Selûne's Dream is in game only as a once per Long Rest action granted by the Amulet of Selûne's Chosen.
sel_ne_s_dream.desc2: An ally you touch regains hit points, but possibly falls asleep. No effect on undead and constructs.

sel_ne_s_ire.name: Selûne's Ire
sel_ne_s_ire.desc1: Selûne's Ire is a level 5 evocation spell. Moonlight Slivers can use this as a reaction to being hit, to deal Radiant damage. It cannot be learned by players and is only used by NPCs.
sel_ne_s_ire.desc2: Strike back at an attacker with holy righteousness. It can use Selûne's Ire again after its next turn.

sethan_reduce.name: Sethan: Reduce
sethan_reduce.desc1: Sethan: Reduce is a level 2 transmutation spell. This spell allows users to decrease a creature's body size. Affected creatures deal less damage with their weapons and have Disadvantage on Strength Ability Checks and Saving Throws. This item spell is a variant of Reduce.

shatter.desc1: Shatter is a level 2 evocation spell. It allows the spellcaster to generate a deafening noise explosion that can damage multiple creatures and objects. This spell is especially potent against inorganic targets, which must make their Saving Throw at Disadvantage.
shatter.desc2: Damages all nearby creatures and objects. Creatures made of inorganic material such as stone have Disadvantage on their Saving throw.

shocking_grasp.desc2: The target cannot use Reactions. This spell has Advantage on creatures with metal Armour.

sights_of_the_seelie_summon_deva.desc2: The Deva can cast Wrathful Smite, Revivify and Concussive Smash.

silence.desc1: Silence is a level 2 illusion spell. It allows spellcasters to summon a sphere of absolute quiet in an area within range. Creatures within this sphere are immune to ⁠Thunder damage and cannot cast verbal spells.
silence.desc2: Create a sound-proof sphere. All within are Silenced and Immune to ⁠Thunder damage. Using this spell might turn targets hostile.

sizzling_cataclysm.name: Sizzling Cataclysm
sizzling_cataclysm.desc1: Sizzling Cataclysm is a level 4 evocation spell. It is a variant of Kereska's Favour that allows its caster to imbue themselves with the power of acid and unlock resistances and spells associated with it. It is granted by Markoheshkir.
sizzling_cataclysm.desc2: Embrace Kereska's acid to gain resistance to ⁠Acid damage. Your acid spells deal additional ⁠Acid damage equal to your proficiency bonus. When you deal spell damage, possibly inflict 3[See Notes] turns of Noxious Fumes upon the target. While attuned to Kereska's acid you can cast Melf's Acid Arrow and Hunger of Hadar once each per short rest. Melf's Acid Arrow () Cast as a level 5 spell ( Recharge: Short rest.) sleet_storm.desc1: Sleet Storm is a level 3 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to call forth a storm that douses fire, creates an icy surface, and disrupts the concentration of spellcasters.
sleet_storm.desc2: Call forth a storm that douses fire, creates an Ice surface, and forces spellcasters to succeed at a Concentration Saving throw in order to maintain Concentration. Ice is a surface that is considered Difficult Terrain. Creatures moving through it have their Movement Speed halved, and will fall Prone on a failed Dexterity Saving throw.

speak_with_dead.desc1: Speak with Dead is a level 3 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to grant a semblance of life to a corpse, allowing it to answer questions.
speak_with_dead.desc2: Grant a semblance of life to a corpse, allowing it to answer questions. Skeletons and creatures killed with ⁠Acid, ⁠Fire, ⁠Lightning, ⁠Necrotic, ⁠Radiant damage no longer have a mouth and can't be made to talk using this spell. Doesn't work on Undead.

spike_growth.desc1: Spike Growth is a level 2 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to transform an area of land into a hazardous spiky terrain. Creatures walking through the area have their speed halved and take Piercing damage.

summon_gilded_hellsboar.desc1: Summon Gilded Hellsboar is a level 1 conjuration spell. It is unique to Helsik, and summons a level 3 Gilded Hellsboar from a corpse. It cannot be learned by players and is only used by NPCs.
summon_gilded_hellsboar.desc2: Summon a boar, its tusks and tapered body agleam with gold, to fight alongside you.

sunbeam.desc2: A beam of brilliant light sears and Blinds all creatures in its path. Until the spell ends, you can recast Sunbeam without expending a spell slot.

untenable_secret.desc1: Untenable Secret is a level 4 enchantment spell. Forces the target to make a Wisdom Saving Throw or be forced to share a secret. Failure to do so results in taking Necrotic damage. It cannot be learned by players and is only used by NPCs.

heat_metal_reapply_damage.desc1: Reapply Heat Metal is a level 2 transmutation spell. This spell allows spellcasters to re-heat up a metal weapon or armour on the targeted creature, forcing them to let go or receive damage or suffer various penalties.
heat_metal_reapply_damage.desc2: Cause a metal Weapon or Armour to glow red-hot and force the creature touching it to let go or receive Disadvantage on Attack rolls and Ability Checks. If the creature is only wearing metal armour, it always receives Disadvantage. If the creature is still touching the metal, you can use a Bonus Action on subsequent turns to Reapply Heat Metal to deal another 2d8⁠⁠Fire damage and force the creature to let go or receive Disadvantage.
heat_metal_reapply_damage.levels: Upcasting: Casting  Heat Metal at a higher level deals an extra 1d8⁠⁠Fire damage for each spell slot level above 2nd when reapplying it.
heat_metal_reapply_damage.flavorText: Reapply Heat Metal is a level 2 transmutation spell. This spell allows spellcasters to re-heat up a metal weapon or armour on the targeted creature, forcing them to let go or receive damage or suffer various penalties.

counterspell.description:

Try to stop a spell being cast. If it is higher level than the spell slot you used to Counterspell, you must make a check using your spellcasting ability[See Notes] to prevent it. The check's difficulty is equal to 10 plus the level of the spell you are trying to counter. This spell can be cast while you are Silenced.

elemental_retort.name: Elemental Retort
elemental_retort.desc1: Elemental Retort is a level 5 evocation spell. It is unique to Lorroakan, allowing him to retaliate with elemental damage siphoned from his myrmidons when attacked. Each of Lorroakan's myrmidons adds 3d8 damage to to this spell and an additional  Reaction to cast it with. It cannot be learned by players and is only used by NPCs.
elemental_retort.desc2: When you take damage, you can retaliate, blasting your attacker with the elemental damage of each myrmidon currently Siphoned.
elemental_retort.levels: Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit.

heartwrench.desc2: Rend a target with a psychic barrage after you or an ally is struck by a Heartform Mapped creature.

hellish_rebuke.name: Hellish Rebuke
hellish_rebuke.desc1: Hellish Rebuke is a level 1 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to surround a creature in hellfire that deals ⁠Fire damage as a  Reaction when taking damage from them.
hellish_rebuke.desc2: React to your next attacker with flames that deal 2d10⁠⁠Fire damage. On a successful save, the target still takes half damage.

punish_divinity.name: Punish Divinity
punish_divinity.desc1: Punish Divinity is a level 6 spell. When Raphael is dealt ⁠Radiant damage, he can use this spell as a reaction to stun the attacker. It cannot be learned by players and is only used by NPCs.
punish_divinity.desc2: After taking ⁠Radiant damage, Stun the attacker, allowing you to Drain its hit points.

sanctuary_of_loss.name: Sanctuary of Loss
sanctuary_of_loss.desc1: Sanctuary of Loss is a level 1 spell. It is cast as a legendary reaction available to Viconia DeVir in Honour mode. It cannot be learned by players and is only used by NPCs.
sanctuary_of_loss.desc2: Shield yourself or an ally from harm after they are attacked. This protection will wane when the protected creature attacks. Viconia can still use Heartwrench and keep this protection.

shield.name: Shield
shield.desc1: Shield is a level 1 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to avoid being hit by an enemy attack at the last possible instant. It also nullifies Magic Missile damage against them.
shield.desc2: When you are about to be hit by an enemy, use your Reaction to increase your Armour Class by 5. You also take no damage from Magic Missile. These effects last until the start of your next turn.

soul_ascension.name: Soul Ascension
soul_ascension.desc1: Soul Ascension is a level 6 evocation spell. It is available to Raphael while he is in his Ascended Fiend form. It creates an area that, while inside, lets his cambions deal Hellfire damage, and causes Necrotic damage to enemies. It cannot be learned by players and is only used by NPCs.
soul_ascension.desc2: Create a column of writhing souls that transforms allied Cambions into Hellfire Cambions and deals 6d10⁠Necrotic to any non-fiend caught inside. Cambions ascended by this cascade deal Hellfire damage, which ignores Resistance and Immunity to Fire damage.

the_dead_wastes.name: The Dead Wastes
the_dead_wastes.desc1: The Dead Wastes is a level 3 necromancy spell. It is cast as a legendary reaction, and is available to Balthazar in Honour mode. It cannot be learned by players and is only used by NPCs.
the_dead_wastes.desc2: Open a necrotic rift from a new corpse that heals Undead 4d6⁠⁠hit points and deals 4d6⁠⁠Necrotic to living creatures at the start of their turns.

vampiric_swarm.name: Vampiric Swarm
vampiric_swarm.desc1: Vampiric Swarm is a level 6 conjuration spell. It is cast as a legendary reaction available to Cazador in Honour mode. It cannot be learned by players and is only used by NPCs.

soul_drain.name: Soul Drain
soul_drain.desc1: Soul Drain is a level 6 spell. It is a free action available to Raphael that lets him restore hit points and deal Necrotic⁠Necrotic damage to creatures that are stunned by Punish Divinity Punish Divinity. It cannot be learned by players and is only used by NPCs.
